verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains extensive Brave Search API feature documentation but no citations describing documented rate limits, concurrency caps, or a self-serve tier-upgrade mechanism; the only pricing-adjacent evidence (comm-2) discusses switching between a standard and an 'AI Inference' plan for ToS compliance, not rate/concurrency limits or an upgrade flow. Missing for 10: documented request-per-second/minute limits, concurrency cap specifications, and a self-serve upgrade path (e.g., dashboard plan upgrade flow).
